plugins.name: shesha-enterprise
plugins.description: Enterprise-focused Shesha skills covering workflow authoring, workflow state analysis, document generation, and reference number configuration.

plugins.name: shesha-utils
plugins.description: Utility skills for Shesha development: project setup, analyzers, integration tests, form config cleanup, permission hardening, backend debug linking, stack upgrades, ShaConfig documentation, Claude logger setup, and skill authoring.

plugins.name: shesha-auto-testing
plugins.description: Automated end-to-end testing toolkit for Shesha framework applications. Provides skills for scaffolding Playwright test infrastructure, authoring test plans, running tests locally and on remote hubs, and syncing results to a central reports dashboard.

plugins.name: boxfusion-infra
plugins.description: Infrastructure and operations skills for Boxfusion/Shesha deployments: housekeeping on Azure App Services and application databases, including Elmah log cleanup (XML files and SQL) and app log cleanup (log4net and scheduled-job logs) on Linux and Windows App Services.

plugins.name: boxfusion-tlc
plugins.description: DRAFT / preview. End-to-end "TLC" diagnosis and framework-native remediation for a BoxFusion Shesha/ABP system: a deterministic specialist sweep across security, code, SQL, the ORM, forms and operations that proves each finding, writes a plain-English no-blame report, and (on approval) ships fixes the Shesha way as PRs. Includes a --security-only breach-response mode.
